headline: CORN RUNS 1.1% AHEAD OF STOCKS, CRUDE UP ON GULF FLOWS
lead: Corn's up 5 cents to $5.04, Chicago wheat added 8 cents to $6.80, and crude ran 3.3% to $92.08, all three moving before Quarterly Stocks even prints at 11 CT. That's not reaction, that's positioning, and positioning ahead of a Stocks report is a bet, not a read.
teaser: Corn and wheat both ran higher ahead of Quarterly Stocks, crude gained 3.3% on Gulf flow reports, nothing's confirmed yet.

one_number.context: Cow slaughter is down 40% since 2022 as producers hold back females, the slowest culling pace on record and the real reason feeders keep finding a bid.

yesterdays_call.note: Corn closed at $5.0375, short of the $5.29 target, so the directional call missed on level despite catching the move up.
yesterdays_call.call_line: Called corn up toward $5.29 ($5.2475 when the call was made). It closed at $5.0375.

action: Unpriced corn in the bin: a close above $5.09 says the Stocks positioning was real, price another 10% there.

sections.title: Grains Run Ahead Of Stocks
sections.body:
- Corn added a penny over a nickel to **$5.04** and wheat gained 8 cents to $6.80, both moving hours before Quarterly Stocks prints at 11 CT today.
- Feedstuffs flagged corn "stumbled significantly lower" in midweek trade, so today's bounce is a reversal of that, not a continuation.
sections.so_what: Today's grain strength is a bet on Stocks, not a verdict on it.

sections.title: Crude Runs On Gulf Flow Reports
sections.body:
- WTI gained 3.3% to **$92.08**, reversing Wednesday's pullback to $96 on Brent after JPMorgan, Goldman and Kpler all flagged Gulf oil flows bouncing back.
- Oilprice.com is also flagging Iran's own oil disappearing from the market even as China's demand recovers, a supply squeeze working against the bounce.
sections.so_what: The Iran-Hormuz premium is building again after deflating all August, call it round three.

outside_the_pit.title: Cow Slaughter Down 40% Since 2022
outside_the_pit.body: Culling's headed for a record-low 7.3% in 2026, producers are holding females back, the rebuild is real and it's slow.

watch_list.desc: Quarterly Stocks prints; corn stocks below trade guess tightens old-crop fast.
Diesel export ban talk; Trump admits a ban could raise gasoline, watch input costs.
Crude above $92.08 on confirmed Gulf flow data keeps the Iran premium building, not fading.

daily_quote.text: The real key to making money in stocks is not to get scared out of them.

source_summary: CME/CBOT settlement data, USDA, oilprice.com, feedstuffs.com, beefmagazine.com, no-tillfarmer.com
